[spoiler=First F-130 purchase and a request for landing.]
[b]First order of F-130s[/b]

With the Joint-Initiative Aircraft Research and Development program having been signed with the Lavians, and some initiate preparation and groundwork having been done in its main military airforce bases and facilities, the military HQ of Nordiheim have sent a production order for 50 F-130 Diamondbacks to be produced for the Nordiheim air force to the Ijesa Dynamics company together with a contract request for logistical and technical support to get everything up and going as fast as possible for when the aircrafts fully arrive.

If the F-130 can be integrated and used by the air force as well as is hoped and expected then it will most likely not be the last order sent to the Lavian company.

[b]Request for testing permission[/b]

A request for testing cooperation and landing permission on a Lavian carrier have also been sent to the Lavian military to gain the ability to perform live carrier landing and take-off tests to aid in the final developing phase of the KJ-8AC.
The reason for this request is that since Nordiheim does not have carriers of its own at this point in time it can not perform these tests itself which could unnecessarily delay the development of the aircraft.
In addition it can also help both parties to gain some hands-on experience with the aircraft and preemptively discover anything that could be advantageous to change or add on the aircraft for the Lavian navy at an early stage.
If everything goes well it is hoped that the KJ-8AC might enter production as early as late 2028 or early 2029.
[/spoiler]

[quote=the_commonwealth_provisional_states;61418583][b]Operation Unrelenting Resolve[/b]

"Mr. President." Willem Ironmoor says, walking into the square office, Julian slumped at his desk from a night of reading reports.

"Uhh. Morning, Director." He looks at him quickly jumping up

"You usually don't visit me, Ironmoor... what's the deal."

Ironmoor sits down in one of the chairs in his office

"Rosenmarkke is jamming our communications. Ground-based anyway, Satcoms are still fully operational."

Julian facepalms and picks up the phone. "Vivian hi, can coffee, some pizza, and you know what, maybe a tub of ice cream be brought up to the sqaure office...yeah, thanks."

"Ironmoor, have you talked to Riderveld about this yet?" Julian says, looking back at Ironmoor

"Yes, I have, infact he's confirmed it on the military side, OSS believes that this is it intentional."

"Your actually kidding me ironmoor? Are you serious...ughhhhh you have to be f*cking kidding me, and here I thought I might get some sleep today." Julian looks towards the phone again

"What can we do about it?"

"We could strike Radio Station Gaga to end the interference, although the legality of that internationally is dubious, its also unknown at this time if our Neue Republik allies would support us in that course of action." Ironmoor coldy replies.

"Alternatives Ironmoor?" Julian replies

"We could try to complain about it to the international community, maybe send a warning to shut it off."

"Thats weakness, and I will not be a weak President. Where going to strike, I want strike options. Get the chiefs of staff here."

__________________________________________________________

By 8 Am in the morning, after hours of continued radio interference, a course of action had been decided upon. Against the advice of Wuloosyan intelligence, the Secretary of State, but with support from the Secretary of War and the Chief of Staffs, President Julian had determined to strike Rosenmarkkee to send a strong message against any future interference with the Wuloosyan Defense Force. The Joint Chiefs of Staff and the president would meet later in the day determine a strike plan, with two plans being devised. Plan A was simple, Wuloosya would launch its newly obtained ballistic missiles across the white sea and destroy the site, or Plan B, the task would be delegated to the 93rd Attack Squadron based on the Manhattienn Peninsula AFB. The 93rd Attack Squadron is one of two 24/7 wuloosyan bomber squadrons, the other being the 81st Attack Squadron, based in Kustalia; however, the 73rd is much closer to the white sea. This plan would involve the bomber squadron taking off equipped with AGM-158 JASSM-ERs, long range stand off cruise misiles and attempt to destroy or severely damage the disruption of the stations. These F-222s would use speed and ability to stick low to the ground as there adventage and penetrate Rosenmarkke coastal air defense, fire their missiles at the jamming station, and then pull out and leave. Plan A would be more effective; however, it may lead to retaliation and waste valuable missiles just in case this is the start of an invasion. While Option B would be riskier, but also be less esclatory, and may leave Wuloosya out of the situation if this goes bad diplomatically. Julian ultimately authorizes Operation B. The Secretary of State, through the Wuloosyan Embassy in the Neue Republic, informs the government of the choice. The 84th Fighter Squadron and the 93rd Attack Squadron are put on full battle alert minutes later, and it will take 2 hours to make the airframes ready for combat. Meanwhile, 2 air-to-air refuelers and a single E-7 "Cramorant" AEW are put over the white sea, ostensibly to refuel Neue Republik aircraft patrolling the Strait, but really to refuel and provide intelligence to the F-25s. A force of Jorik Halden-class missile destroyers and an Aric Stonevik-class frigate is made ready to enter the white sea for defensive purposes. For the rest of the army, a Defense Warning Status 2 goes out, meaning all military units should begin preparation for armed conflict, and all soldiers of the base should begin to make their way back. 2 Wuyloosan Surveillance Satellites are currently positioned over Rosenmarkke, and they begin providing intelligence for a nighttime strike on the station. At 8 pm, all fighters of the 93rd Attack Squadron take off and begin waking there way to Rosenmarkkee, escorted by a scrambled 84th Fighter Squadron, equipped with the best Wuloosyan aircraft available, the F-25 Novivern, all taking up their air interceptor loadouts. Blitzing across the White Sea, the fighters and bombers would refuel just outside of the Wuloosyan EEZZ before continuing. The F-222s begin there final approach entering the Rosenmarkke eez, the HDF is supposed to be suppressing Rosenmarkket air defenses, so hopefully this will give them enough time, once reaching 200kms away all 10 F-222s would launch there AGM-158B JASSM-ERs at already designated targets that had been causing the disruptions, these missiles have a range of aroun 900km and overall 60 of them are launched, the F-222s and the F-25s would then begin to attempt to bolt away to evade any Rosenmarkkee air defense. Back at the square office, Julian sits slumped in his seat. Maybe he had overreacted? No. He had done the right thing; these Rosenmarkket xenos will learn that he is not weak, and Wuloosya will defend itself. It now awaits the OSS to confirm if the strikes had been effective.

[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation]
[nation]Neue Republik[/nation][/quote]

[b]Hellfire like never before[/b]

It was 10 PM when the SCSID informed the chief consul that Wuloosya had deployed its 93rd attack squadron as well as the Neue Republik beginning emissions suppression tactics. 

Strømm, never the one to cause a scene, especially in an opera box, simply informed General Menkins to Do what needed to be done, and let me handle the optics before returning calmly to view the opera which was playing that night.

Menkins knew Rosenmarkke had only but an hour to two hours to create a cohesive deterrence package for both the HDF and the WDF.  

After a series of phone calls and quick meetings Menkins would create a compelling and hopefully coherent plan to stop the two forces that threatened the nation.

First he would order 10-12 S-400 Battalions to activate in 30-60 second windows around key radio stations and jammer stations, with the radars briefly turning on and off in 10 second intervals. This would create a blinking pattern across the system, however, Menkins knew that the HDF and WDF probably had accounted for a shoot n-scoot model to be utilised by Rosenmarkke, and as such, he ordered the deployment of ghost radar emitters across the targeted and non-targeted areas, as well as false SAM units. 

In order to ensure a layered response a three tier SAM system would be moved into position with the SAM units firing at the JASSM-ERs, however, due to the combined stress of the HDFs suppression tactics, the SAM bursts would be mandated to remain short, 

In order to counter the SEAD the radars would relocate immediately following their initial burst, along with the aid of a blanket of false emitters, however 3 S-400 units would be damaged with 2 S-300s being destroyed due to operational delay. 

Following this, there still were approximately 25-30 JASSM-ERs en route to the various targeted stations, which would be fired at by the NASAM and IRIS-TL systems. However, these would only be moderately successful thereby causing 15 of the JASSM-ERs to hit their planned targets, destroying 5 of the 15 radio jamming stations along the coastline and islands of Rosenmarkke and damaging 3 more.

Following this, Menkins, cussing out the NASAM and IRIS-TL battalions over the phone, would order 32 Mig-29 interceptors into the air beyond missile range, 1 Su-20 as a watch-craft, and 2 AEW craft to begin immediate surveillance of the White Sea, utilising a racetrack scanning pattern. 

By this time Strømm would return to the National House, and begin immediate damage briefings, with degradation of coastal interference networks, the chances of Rosenmarkke blocking any potential land invasion would be reduced, but not eliminated. 

Strømm would order thus, two main objectives:

[list]
Activation of the reserve fleet
Move a contingency of 3 diesel electric submarines into the White Sea
[/list]

Reasoning that if Wuloosya had brought in Neue Republik aide, then there was far more planned than just minor strikes to interference equipment.

In order to ensure public calm, she would appear on the nations biggest morning show the morning following the strikes and would be cited as saying:

Last night, the heinous enemies of Rosenmarkke sought to destroy and eliminate our defenses through various means and devious plans, however, our strength and our power thwarted their plans to defeat this state and subdue its government. Rosenmarkke remains committed to its allies and to its defense. Our enemies may seek to destroy us, but I tell you this, as long as the sun rises from the East, and sets in the West, Rosenmarkke shall prevail! 

Our enemies are aware of how we routed the Montfleurois in 1815 and secured independence, they know of the strength of our workers, who secured victory in 1840 for the people. This is why they attack us, because my friends, my citizens, because they know of our strength. 

My fellow citizens, When the Thrømm laid eyes on this land 3,000 years ago and when the creator said to them This shall be your land he made a promise to them that they would not perish, even though the sea should overwhelm them! Today that promise stands, last night that promise stood, and tomorrow that promise shall stand!

[spoiler=Unifying all of the Shamatan Aboriginals.]
While the recovery and rebuilding of the nation was still on-going it could certainly be said to be going rather well, so well in fact that some political groups within Kuhaw-Astan started to bring up the idea of contacting the other small nations that shared the same ancestral descent of hailing from the North-eastern migration wave that brought the ancestors of the Kuhawan people to the island of Astan (or Astanir as some call it) and the other small islands that is part of the Shamat continent.

After some debate it was finally decided that there would not hurt the young nation to reach out to the other Aboriginals that lived on the Shamatan continents.
There were three small nations that were known to be of Aboriginal decent;
To the north-east there was the island of Balagaba that the Bala tribe called home and the tiny island of Tocalgala where the Yaburung tribe made their home.
Meanwhile to the south-west of Kuhaw-Astan, on the south-eastern coast of West-Shamat, was the small coastal nation of Dulili-Wanja that was made up of the two large tribes of Djuwa and Qawma.

It did not take long for these small nations to reply to the question of joining their small nations together with Kuhaw-Astan to make a stronger nation as they understood that they were weaker alone then together, and as such they would send diplomats to the capitol of Kuhaw-Astan, Muhakay, to discuss this topic in greater and deeper detail to see if this was something that their tribes would commit to both as a way to unify the east Aboriginal peoples, who had been divided for so long, and to figure out if this was something that they truly would gain something from that made it worth letting go of some of their sovereignty for.
While the Bala and Yaburung did not have many points that the needed to negotiate about the Djuwa and Qawma on the other hand had a firm prerequisit to them considering a unification of the east Aboriginal tribes, the question of the Shaman people in Kuhaw-Astan and their rights had to be addressed and legal rights be writhen into the nations laws to give them future protection.
While this was not a supricing demand from them considering that their tribes had unified and merged with the Shaman people over 2000 years ago in their coastal land to enable them to live in peace there was some groups in Kuhaw-Astan that was of the more nationalistic type that were not overly fond of this demand, fortunatly the representatives of the Sui and Mana tribes worked hard in the background to get enough of the tribal groups of the Kuhawan to agree to this demand as they had been conserned that the Shaman issue had been avoided several times the last 2 years in the Tribal Senate even though it needed to be adressed for future stability and harmony, now it might finaly be propperly discussed and resolved in a manner that could prevent future problems.

After more then a week a proper agreement would be reached and it would be sendt back to the tribes so that it could be shared among their people and a vote could be called on to be done to see if they would agree to such a union to take place.
[/spoiler]

The royal family followed Galina throughout the halls, and when the large double doors were opened, they took a few moments to admire the extravagant chamber. The lack of a television was not an issue, as they did not watch it.

The Corzerranean king approached Galina. [i]"I thank you, and Queen Elena, for this most elegant lodging provided."[/i]

Meanwhile, the twin guards set down the luggage of the family and began to unpack. The princes and princess took possession of their belongings from them. The Queen moved to join Zachariasz at his side.[/quote]
[i]"Of course, your majesty."[/i] She nodded curtly and dismissed herself to her office, for there were schedules to be made.

Lunch was light fare, salad, soup, and either fish or chicken breast depending on guest choice. The meal passed with some idle chatter and the weeks' plans. Afterwards, Elena led the family on a brief tour of the Palace, showcasing the library, meeting hall, the beautiful campus and more.

Since there wasn't an itinerary till the next day, the rest of the evening was for leisure and conversation- except for Elena. She had gotten a call from one of the Governors, and she returned with stress playing on her face.

[quote=corzerran;61421344]Cecilia beamed. [i]"If it wouldn't be too much of an issue, would some coffee be available? Preferably with milk and a bit of sugar."[/i]

After a few moments, she took notice of Elena's tired state. [i]"Are you doing alright? If need be, I can help you with some arrangements. Please, don't wear yourself out."[/i] She gently cupped Elena's cheek with the palm of her hand. [i]"It seems like you've been working too long. Have you been working all ten hours the royal family has been here?"[/i][/quote]
She waved a hand dismissively, [i]"No, no. The Governors, they've been trouble. But I had somewhat of a... clarifying conversation with the King. It's the follow through that worries me now."[/i] she chuckled dryly, [i]"But that's pillow talk,"[/i] she began moving towards the kitchen for coffee, [i]"The Royal Family has been delightful company, I got to learn a lot about you from the Princess."[/i] she laughed, strolling to the sink and filling a tea kettle and setting it on the stove.
